contract: All public landing pages share the configured school theme, derive accents from the base color instead of fixed orange/gold values, align card grids with the hero container, keep deliberate spacing, and remain readable responsively.

accessibility.evidence: Public pages expose labelled navigation and headings; all nine audited routes loaded without browser console or page errors.

responsive.evidence: Audited public routes kept document and body scroll widths equal to the viewport at 1440px, 375px, and an additional 320px narrow-width check; section card grids align to the 1180px hero container with 24px desktop spacing and simulated green base rendering contained no legacy orange/gold computed colors.

loading.reason: This change targets rendered landing-page surfaces after navigation completes.

empty.evidence: News, gallery, and organization empty states remain visible inside contained themed surfaces.

error.evidence: Nine public routes produced zero console errors and zero page errors during navigation.

partial.reason: No partial-data behavior was changed by the shared visual layer.

success.reason: No mutation or submission flow is part of this landing-page audit.

renderedEvidence.observation: Academic landing page now uses the shared blue hero, rounded surface, clipped decoration, and themed cards.
Academic landing page remains readable on mobile with contained hero and stacked cards.
Homepage rendered with a green base uses green-derived accent text and no fixed orange/gold accent in the hero.
Homepage receives the green primary and matching green accent directly from the backend theme payload; hero remains readable and contained.
Kesiswaan cards align to the hero width, sit below it with a deliberate gap, and maintain readable contrast in the feature card.
News cards align to the hero container and now have a visible 24px separation from the hero instead of touching its bottom edge.
Gallery album cards align to the hero container with a consistent 24px section gap and 24px internal grid gap.
Gallery cards remain contained on mobile, stack without horizontal overflow, and retain the same deliberate hero-to-grid spacing.
